title: Cash rewards

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

action.description: What earns the reward, from the game's table name: `PlayerKill`, `Heal`, `Revive`, `VehicleDestroyed`, `Repair`, `Refuel`, `Spotting`, `ControlZoneReward`, ...

context.description: The case within the action, the game's context tag without its `Meta.Progression.Context.` prefix (a vehicle variant id for vehicle-specific rewards).

description.description: The game's own note on when the case applies.

modifiers.description: The other numbers of the row, named as the game names them (`FriendlyModifier`, `ModifierCZ` for control zones, `ModifierHZ` for hot zones, `AssistBaseModifier`, ...). They scale or adjust the base amount depending on who and where.

rewards.description: Reward cases, sorted by action then by the order of the game's table.

description: Cash rewards for in-game actions (kills, heals, revives, repairs, building, objectives) with their base amounts and modifiers. The game also has a challenge reward system (challenge-rewards.json) with its own formulas and different numbers (a player kill has a base of 250 here and 300 there); the files do not say which one the live game pays by.
